name: Yunding Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yunding Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 1993 and headquartered in Jinan, China, primarily focuses on the extraction of iron ores and the subsequent processing and distribution of iron concentrates. The company also maintains a diverse business portfolio, which includes the sale of tires, retail of traditional Chinese medicine, and the licensing of proprietary coal chemical patent technology. Additionally, it specializes in system integration, undertakes custom research and development projects for equipment, and delivers comprehensive operational support services, encompassing system installation, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance.
